Query:
UNLOAD (SELECT eiaid_weights.eiaid AS eiaid, sum(1) AS metadata_rows_count, count(distinct(bs.bldg_id)) AS model_count, sum(bs.weight * eiaid_weights.weight) AS units_count, sum(bs."out.site_energy.net.energy_consumption" * bs.weight * eiaid_weights.weight) AS "site_energy.net.energy_consumption", sum(bs."out.site_energy.total.energy_consumption" * bs.weight * eiaid_weights.weight) AS "site_energy.total.energy_consumption" FROM resstock_2024_amy2018_release_2_metadata AS bs JOIN eiaid_weights ON bs."in.county" = eiaid_weights.gisjoin WHERE bs.applicability = true AND bs.upgrade = 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1)
